name: Kuo ni Umareshi Hiaika
original_name: 垢汚に生まれし悲哀歌
source:
Main character is a professor of the university. To collect data for report about worships in Heisei period he travels to a distant village. But what he only learns there is crazy customs and fanatic people...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名大学教授。为了给一份关于平成时期信仰崇拜的报告搜集资料，他来到一座偏远村庄。然而，他在那里见识到的，只有疯狂的习俗与狂热的村民……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
